name: sale-catalogue
title: Draft sale catalogue
for_each: select id,sale,lot_no from lots order by sale,lot_no

sections.title: Lot
sections.note: Operator review required. No sale or slaughter clearance is certified.
sections.sql: select l.sale,l.lot_no,l.sale_date,a.tag,a.name,a.born,a.sex,a.breed,a.sire_tag,a.dam_tag,a.society_id,l.notes from lots l join animals a on a.id=l.animal_id where l.id=$1

sections.title: Recorded breeding values
sections.note: Only compare values from the same breed analysis and run. Values are stored, not calculated.
sections.sql: select e.trait,e.value,e.accuracy,e.run_date,e.analysis from ebvs e join lots l on l.animal_id=e.animal_id where l.id=$1 order by e.trait,e.run_date desc

name: treatment-register
title: Treatment record
for_each: select id,tag from animals where status='active' order by tag

sections.title: Treatments
sections.note: Dates come from records entered by the operator. Verify label, veterinarian instructions and destination.
sections.sql: select treated,product,batch,product_expiry,dose,meat_clear,export_clear,instruction_ref,operator from treatments where animal_id=$1 order by treated

name: movement-checklist
title: Movement preparation checklist
for_each: select id,external_id from movements order by moved_at

sections.title: Consignment record
sections.note: This is not an NVD, ASD, NLIS or NAIT submission. Use the official service and record its receipt.
sections.sql: select a.tag,a.eid,m.from_code,m.to_code,m.moved_at,m.direction,m.country,m.document_ref,m.recorded_at,m.receipt from movements m join animals a on a.id=m.animal_id where m.id=$1

sections.title: Treatment history
sections.sql: select t.treated,t.product,t.meat_clear,t.export_clear,t.instruction_ref from treatments t join movements m on m.animal_id=t.animal_id where m.id=$1 order by t.treated

name: calving-book
title: Calving book
for_each: select id,tag from animals where sex='F' order by tag

sections.title: Joinings
sections.sql: select s.tag as sire,j.joined,j.due,j.method,j.result from joinings j join animals s on s.id=j.sire_id where j.dam_id=$1 order by joined

sections.title: Calves
sections.sql: select a.tag,c.calved,c.birth_kg,c.assistance from calvings c join animals a on a.id=c.calf_id where c.dam_id=$1 order by calved
